name: Bread Makes the Heart Aflutter - The Baker's First Ball
source:
Several months after the spring that brought Emile and Damon together, the Selias Capital is abuzz again, this time with the annual Autumn Charity Ball being just around the corner! When Damon learns that Emile's never been to any balls before — for anything other than work — he personally invites him to be his partner, and the two prepare to make it the most memorable one yet.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4482740//]Steam[/url]]
translation:
距离让埃米尔与达蒙走到一起的那个春天已过去数月，塞利亚斯王都再度热闹非凡——一年一度的秋季慈善舞会即将拉开帷幕！当达蒙得知埃米尔除了工作差事之外从未真正参加过任何舞会时，便亲自邀请他担任自己的舞伴，两人也着手准备让这场舞会成为有史以来最难忘的一夜。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4482740//]Steam[/url]]
